//go:build sessionless_search_offline

package localloopback

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/x509"
	"net"
	"net/netip"

	"gitcode.com/urandon/sessionless/internal/domain"
)

// Additive test binary only. It substitutes controlled DNS/socket/TLS DATA,
// never original Source/Store/claim/grant/consent/HMAC or before-send authority.
func (k *KeeperV1) ConfigureSearchOfflineNetwork(lookup func(context.Context, string) ([]netip.Addr, error), dial func(context.Context, string, string) (net.Conn, error), roots *x509.CertPool) error {
	if k == nil || k.self != k || lookup == nil || dial == nil || roots == nil {
		return domain.ErrMembershipDenied
	}
	k.mu.Lock()
	defer k.mu.Unlock()
	if k.closed || k.active != nil || k.credentialScopeUsed || k.credentialScope != nil || k.credentialEnded || k.searchSlots != 0 || k.sourceLifetime == nil || k.sourceLifetime.Err() != nil || k.searchDeps.lookup != nil || k.searchDeps.dial != nil || k.searchDeps.roots != nil {
		return domain.ErrMembershipDenied
	}
	if _, _, err := k.bootstrap.RuntimeFor(k); err != nil {
		return domain.ErrMembershipDenied
	}
	k.searchDeps = searchHTTPSDependencies{lookup: lookup, dial: dial, roots: roots.Clone()}
	return nil
}

// Shutdown-only test control over the SAME owned connection. No connection,
// key, capability or publication proof escapes the borrow's original owner.
func (k *KeeperV1) StopActiveSearchOffline() error {
	if k == nil || k.self != k {
		return domain.ErrMembershipDenied
	}
	k.mu.Lock()
	c := k.active
	if k.closed || c == nil {
		k.mu.Unlock()
		return domain.ErrMembershipDenied
	}
	c.mu.Lock()
	valid := c.self == c && c.keeper == k && c.search != nil && c.ready && !c.used && !c.closed && c.conn != nil
	c.mu.Unlock()
	k.mu.Unlock()
	if !valid {
		return domain.ErrMembershipDenied
	}
	return c.Close()
}
